Uses of Package
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott

Packages that use com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott
One-time token authentication: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a primary sign-in method and as a second factor, the per-channel factors, the rate limits, the providers and filters, and the phone management API and account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott
Use cases of the one-time-code (e-mail and SMS) authentication factor: requesting, verifying and cleaning up codes, and the policy beans they share.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott
One-time tokens: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a sign-in method.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail
Mail adapter of the authorization server: delivers one-time tokens and account e-mails.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.ott
PostgreSQL implementations of the one-time token ports: the codes of the email and SMS one-time code login (over the ott_codes table) and the Spring Security one-time token service of the magic links (over the one_time_tokens table).
